system.effect:
You are Trained in Melee: add this Constellation's Proficiency Bonus to your attack rolls with any weapon in your hand, and to Gain Control. You gain the Intercept ❶↺ Reaction. At Expert rank in Melee you also gain the Counter ❶↺ Reaction.
Special Intuitive weapons use your full Melee Proficiency Bonus. Practiced or Technical weapons do not; see Chapter 5: Equipment for rules on Weapon Traits.
